subject: integration
name: Load from EthFS files on Ethereum
summary: The EthFS row of the load order: loads the file a .eth name's record names as eth://0x<pointer>, reading its chunks through the Ethereum nodes the person ordered, one block per node, and holding every byte against the CREATE2 address. A node that lies is skipped, a withholding node passes the read on, and only a proving node can end it. Not Level 4: loading depends on those nodes, by default Helios and a few public servers, which also see the file asked for; a File part no address commits to is served only by a proving node. Judged here by its publisher.
